نتمذهب (form IIq)
# نَتَمَذْهَبُ (natamaḏhabu) /na.ta.mað.ha.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَذْهَبَ (tamaḏhaba)
# نَتَمَذْهَبَ (natamaḏhaba) /na.ta.mað.ha.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَذْهَبَ (tamaḏhaba)
# نَتَمَذْهَبْ (natamaḏhab) /na.ta.mað.hab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَذْهَبَ (tamaḏhaba)
